source.title: Continental Championships 2024 Announcement - Europe & North America
source.content:
As announced at the closing ceremonies of the respective championships, we are happy to announce that **Pamplona, Spain** will be hosting the 2024 WCA European Championship and **Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA** will be hosting the 2024 WCA North American Championship. 
 
You can view the application documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Zqj38Vx7Cy3ApUpEZOI6MOoIneMUro9A) (WCA European Championship) and [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrcxDLsSC8vOXInsX82zbOheBan5T26_) (WCA North American Championship). There were no other applicants for these championships. 
 
In addition to the above, we also had open applications for 2024 championships for Asia and South America. No applications were received for these areas. Additional application periods will open shortly.

translation.title: 2024 年大洲锦标赛举办地公布：欧洲及北美洲
translation.content:
正如各自锦标赛闭幕式上公布的消息，**西班牙潘普洛纳**将举办 2024 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛，**美国明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯**将举办 2024 年 WCA 北美洲锦标赛。

申办材料可分别在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Zqj38Vx7Cy3ApUpEZOI6MOoIneMUro9A)（欧洲锦标赛）和[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrcxDLsSC8vOXInsX82zbOheBan5T26_)（北美洲锦标赛）查看。这两项锦标赛均无其他申办团队。

此外，我们此前也开放了 2024 年亚洲和南美洲锦标赛的申办，但未收到申请。新的申办窗口将于近期开放。
